beats.text: Rule number one of Blackwood Creek: When the village bells strike thirteen at midnight... you do not stay out in the mist.
Old man Miller slammed open his shutter, tossing down a rusted iron key. Kid! Get inside the cabin right now! He smells you... and he's off the chain!
Then, the street went dead silent. The puddles began to ripple. An immense shadow stretched forty feet across the gravel road.
Rising out of the black pines was the Colossus of Hollow Creek. Two burning red eyes staring down through the fog... and a jaw of jagged razor fangs.
With a bone-shattering roar, it charged! I lunged for the cabin door as its razor claws slammed into the dirt behind me! Did I make it inside in time? Comment for Part Two!
